_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); hotel signals

pit_profile.why: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management and franchising, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We operate or franchise 2,832 lodging properties worldwide, with 513,832 rooms as of year-end 2006'; 'The lodging industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel and timeshare properties for customers'; 'The profitability of the hotels, vacation timeshare resorts and corporate apartments that we operate or franchise may be adversely affected by a number of factors, including: ... international, national and regional economic and geopolitical conditions'; and 'if the amount of sales made through Internet intermediaries increases significantly, our business and profitability may be harmed' (its own FY2006 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management and franchising, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We operate or franchise 2,832 lodging properties worldwide, with 513,832 rooms as of year-end 2006'; 'The lodging industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel and timeshare properties for customers'; 'The profitability of the hotels, vacation timeshare resorts and corporate apartments that we operate or franchise may be adversely affected by a number of factors, including: ... international, national and regional economic and geopolitical conditions'; and 'if the amount of sales made through Internet intermediaries increases significantly, our business and profitability may be harmed' (its own FY2006 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.59x; -3% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.60; conservative 2yr +82%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -45.8%/yr (worst year FY98-FY06, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +18.5%/yr (Q4 fee guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.8-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +18.5%/yr (FY98-FY06 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +31.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY98-FY06); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MAR (retrospective, 2008-01-11) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.59x (66.5% downside to Bear $11 / +113.0% upside to Bull $70) | Adj composite 3.25 vs market 1.65: gap +1.60 [UNDERVALUED] | -3% above the EPP floor $34 (18x FY07E $1.89) | Conservative 2-yr case: +81.5% total (+40.8%/yr) | At 17.4x FY07E the 15% hurdle price $43 sits at or below the BASE case; North American RevPAR +7.2% in Q3 2007, forward fee revenue +14-17% (Q4 2007 fee revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
